name: replace-doodad-grid
description: test.md 'Replacing a 2x2-texture doodad with a 4x4 one in the World Editor': Advanced (260,41) > Replace Doodads... (288,257) opens 'Replace Doodads' (460x377 at 450,310): Old Doodad's category (563,363) Trees/Destructibles (505,459), its list's second row Barrel LTbs (520,421; the list starts LTlt, LTbs, LTbr, LTbx, LTex, LTba, LOcg, LTcr at 408 in steps of 13, not the palette's order); New Doodad's category (793,363) Trees/Destructibles (735,459), Crates LTcr (750,499; 4x4 texture); OK (791,674). Selected Doodads Only unticked: every barrel. Input: paste-centre.w3m's three barrels, on the 2x2 grid once loaded (-480, 992; -928, 672; 608, 672). Studio: w3.terrain.replaceDoodads {from LTbs, to LTcr} once the doodads are on their grids. MEASURED (2026-11-15, branch paste-centre-we): the editor puts each crate on the 4x4 grid, halves going up (-448, 1024; -896, 704), facing kept, as Studio; it leaves the third barrel (608, 672) a barrel: its crate (640, 704) would overlap the tree LTlt at 704, 640. Studio replaces it (doodads[10], ignored here: a known difference, bugs.md)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const snapped = () => s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.find((d) => d.id === 'LTlt')?.position[0] === -128; for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !snapped(); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (!snapped()) throw new Error('the doodads were not put on their grids on load'); const n = await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.replaceDoodads', { from: 'LTbs', to: 'LTcr' }); if (!(n >= 2)) throw new Error('replaced ' + n); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.editors.saveAll();
